mapping.notes: M20 Disentomb's verified return, then Track Down's 'If it's a ... card, draw a card.' Conditional (judged on the returned card) with SUBTYPE_EQ Zombie. packs in tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/: cemetery_recruitment_non_zombie_draws_nothing, cemetery_recruitment_zombie_draws_one.

clauses.clause: Return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
clauses.evidence: [cast targets=[you_fallen]]: target slot 1..1 of [you_fallen] only (the opponent's Zombie card and the Sorcery cards are not offered); 'you_fallen moves graveyard -> hand (by card/MOVE_ZONE)'. Pack C03_3 refuses an opponent's creature card and a non-creature card of mine.

clauses.clause: If it's a Zombie card, draw a card.
clauses.evidence: Same cast: the returned card is 'Your Fallen Zombie', and 'you draws you:Library 5#1' - exactly one card for me (hand 7 -> 8 with the Zombie back, library 6 -> 5; the 'ask discard' is the cleanup hand-size discard from 8). The trace has only the Zombie case; pack C03_1 pins the other branch (a non-Zombie returns and nothing is drawn, with Zombie cards elsewhere in play) and C03_2 the Zombie draw.
